effect_description_eng: [On Play] [When Digivolving] You may suspend 1 Digimon. Then, 1 of your Digimon gets +3000 DP until the end of your opponent's turn.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Opponent's Turn] [Once Per Turn] When an opponent's Digimon attacks, you may switch the target of attack to 1 of your suspended Digimon with the [Insectoid] trait.
